scenario: Customer disputes a charge and pays the outstanding balance by card.
notes: Baseline. Well-formed entities inside full-sentence turns, which is the easiest case for the model.

conversation.text: Thank you for calling billing support, my name is Daniel. Who am I speaking with today?
Hi Daniel, this is Maya Chen. I'm calling about a charge on my account I don't recognize.
I can help with that. Could you confirm the phone number and email address on the account?
Sure, the number is 206-555-0148 and the email is maya.chen@example.com.
Thank you. I see a duplicate equipment fee of forty dollars. I've submitted a credit for that.
Great. I'd like to pay the remaining balance now with my Visa, 4111 1111 1111 1111, expiry 04/28.
That payment went through. You'll see the credit on your next statement.
